pooling_rule: Pool all public target-normal images across the acquisition conditions of one category into a single calibration pool (e.g. overexposed+underexposed+shift_1+shift_2+shift_3 for rice).
scientific_rationale: Same object category is a shared prior; mechanically reaches >=8 unique images.
categories_affected: rice, sheet_metal, vial (and the DEV-side can/fruit_jelly/wallplugs if admitted)
deployment_plausibility: NO: overexposed and underexposed are opposite acquisition corruptions and shift_1/shift_2/shift_3 are distinct regimes. A user facing one concrete target shift would never calibrate the threshold with normal images from a different acquisition regime; a pooled set describes no single deployed setting.
semantic_risk: CROSS_DOMAIN: mixes distinct acquisition regimes into a pool that matches no actual target domain; a threshold calibrated on the mixture has no defined deployment meaning and violates S2/S3.
reason: Fails S2 (no single target-domain scientific meaning) and S3 (deployment implausibility).

pooling_rule: Pad a short target pool with source-domain normal images (public good regular / train / validation) to reach 8.
scientific_rationale: More normal images exist if regular-domain normals are included.
deployment_plausibility: NO: source-domain (regular) normals are the reference domain being adapted AWAY from; using them as target calibration support is explicitly 'source-normal filling target-normal', which the stage forbids.
semantic_risk: SOURCE_FILLING: source-domain images do not represent the target acquisition shift, nullifying the point of adaptation.
reason: Fails S2/S3 and is an explicitly forbidden operation (source-normal to fill target-normal).

pooling_rule: Supplement a short public pool with unlabeled normals from test_private / test_private_mixed to reach 8.
scientific_rationale: Additional normal-looking images exist in held-out private splits.
deployment_plausibility: NO: the private splits carry no acquisition-condition label (are mixed), so their target-domain identity under acquisition shift cannot be established; they cannot be shown to belong to the same target regime, and their status is excluded upstream.
semantic_risk: UNLABELED_DOMAIN: cannot define the target-domain semantics without condition labels; risks including images outside the target regime.
reason: Fails S2 (no verifiable target-domain identity) and S4 (membership not defined by condition metadata); excluded split, OUT_OF_SCOPE.

pooling_rule: Run with (n<8) support and still report it as fixed K=8.
scientific_rationale: None (label-substitution is not a pooling protocol).
deployment_plausibility: NO: claims an 8-sample estimate with <8 real target-normal observations.
semantic_risk: PSEUDO_EXPANSION: explicitly forbidden ('K=min(8,n) but still labelled K8').
reason: Fails S6 and is an explicitly forbidden pseudo-expansion; not a real pooling protocol.
